programmes.d: It's a Caribbean island in a sea of cash as the World Poker Tour makes landfall in sunny Aruba for the $3,000,000 Aruba Poker Classic.
The World Poker Tour tips its hat to a poker legend with a $4,000,000 shootout worthy of the great Doyle Brunson himself.
There is a mountain of money in the hills of New England as six poker warriors fight for their share of a $7.8 million dollar prize pool.
Two time WPT finalist David Singer takes on a 24 year old Anders Henriksson, 22 year old Steve Paul-Ambrose and two 18 year old poker savants in the $5,600,000 Caribbean Poker Adventure.
A river runs through one of the most power packed finals in World Poker Tour history as perennial bridesmaid Scotty Nguyen tries to break his final table jinx in Mississippi.
The World Poker Tour heads back to the shore for a seaside poker battle at the multi-million dollar final of the Borgata Poker Classic.
In the city of angels, this WPT final table will be one lucky player's heaven on earth as six poker pros vie for an enormous prize pool of over $6.6 million dollars.
In Hollywood the red carpet leads to the green felt at one of the most glamorous stops on the World Poker Tour, the prestigious WPT Invitational.
In Northern California six players set their sights on poker glory and draw dead aim on a million dollar first place prize.
The World Poker Tour heads back to the woods of Connecticut where a Yale senior is looking to ace this final and pocket the lion's share of a $4,000,000 prize pool.
The biggest little city in the world hosts the largest tournament in Northern Nevada history and the World Poker Tour captures all the final table excitement.
Bring your earplugs and put the kids to bed because the WPT Bad Boys of Poker are back in action and badder than ever.
In Las Vegas, an $83,000,000 dollar season ends in the biggest WPT event in history with every turn of a card worth nearly four million dollars to the winner.
